guard: frozen legacy suites retain exact parsed indices, including moves by a complete shard cycle and removals
why: Derived shard equality is weaker than the frozen legacy invariant. Moving a suite by four
positions in the four-shard topology preserves its runner but changes the exact index. The
mutation restores that modulo-only comparison; the named whole-cycle cell must redden. A
second mutation proves the property examines every surviving legacy suite.

mutations.name: compare only modulo four so a full-cycle index move disappears
mutations.expectRed: a mid-file whole-shard insert reports every frozen suite whose index changed
mutations.cell: a mid-file whole-shard insert reports every frozen suite whose index changed

mutations.name: stop counting examined legacy suites
mutations.expectRed: the whole-shard property examined every frozen suite
mutations.cell: the whole-shard property examined every frozen suite
